audience: real estate agents and teams who keep their leads in BoldTrail kvCORE

useCases.title: Find a contact by email address
useCases.text: Search contacts by exact email address to find one lead without paging through all of them.

useCases.title: List the leads of one agent since a date
useCases.text: Filter contacts by assigned agent id and registration time. Page through the results, up to 500 contacts per page.

useCases.title: Find leads with a hashtag
useCases.text: Search contacts by hashtag to group leads for a campaign or a follow-up.

useCases.title: Add a lead for an agent as a private contact
useCases.text: Search for the email first, because the API accepts duplicates. Then create the contact, assigned to an agent and kept private to that agent.
